about: Katherine L. McArthur is the founder and owner of the McArthur Law Firm, which has its offices in Atlanta, Georgia. Licensed to practice law in Georgia since 1980, she focuses her practice exclusively on personal injury matters, including wrongful death, car accidents, truck crashes and medical malpractice.

Ms. McArthur, with a genuine concern for her clients, fights aggressively for the rights and liberties of her clients. She understands the negative effects of being injured because of the negligent and careless actions of another party and strives to ensure that justice is served. She communicates well and keeps her clients informed throughout the whole case. She is firmly committed to her clients’ needs and interests.

Graduating with a Bachelor of Science degree in business administration from the University of North Carolina, Ms. McArthur was the recipient of the Order of The Old Well and Order of St. Andrews honors. She was also the co-chairman of UNC’s Honor Court. She earned her Juris Doctor from the University of North Carolina School of Law.

Ms. McArthur is extremely active in the legal field and has memberships in the Macon Bar Association, the State Bar of Georgia, the Georgia Association for Women Lawyers, the American Board of Trial Advocates, the American Association for Justice, the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, the Middle Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, the National Board of Trial Advocacy, the American Bar Association, the Civil Justice PAC and the Public Justice Foundation.

In recognition of her exceptional legal contributions, Ms. McArthur has received numerous awards and accolades. She has an AV Preeminent* peer review rating by Martindale Hubbell, she has been included in the list of Top 100 Trial Lawyers by The National Trial Lawyers and she has been recognized as one of the Top Lawyers of Georgia by the National Law Journal. Ms. McArthur has also been included in the list of Best Lawyers in America by U.S. News & World Report. Atlanta magazine named her to its list of Top Women Attorneys in Georgia.

Additionally, Ms. McArthur is on the list of Top 100 Litigation Lawyers in the State of Georgia named by the American Society of Legal Advocates and has a “Superb” rating on Avvo. For obtaining several million-dollar and multimillion-dollar verdicts and settlements on behalf of her clients, she is a member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum and the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum.

Ms. McArthur is also an enthusiastic participant in the pro bono field and is an active member at the Girl Scouts of Middle Georgia and the Martha Bowman United Methodist Church. She is an excellent orator and has taught in many continuing legal education seminars and has spoken about various legal topics in many prominent legal associations.

In addition to Georgia, Ms. McArthur is also admitted to practice before the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Georgia, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit, the Supreme Court of Georgia, the Supreme Court of the United States of America, the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Georgia and the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Georgia.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
